ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, right-angled triangles $AOB$ and $COD$ are positioned as depicted (with the right-angled vertices coinciding). Given that $\angle AOC=45^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle DEB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOC=45^\circ$ and $\angle C=45^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AFE=\angle AOC+\angle C=90^\circ$.\\
Since $\angle A=30^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AEF=60^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle DEB=\angle AEF=\boxed{60^\circ}$.
